discretization: Two lumped capacitive nodes, one eliminated monotone algebraic node, one prescribed boundary; no spatial mesh

stiff-nonlinear-heater.oracle: Independent Newton elimination and step-refined RK4 with event bisection; enthalpy integral and algebraic balance checked at every sample

equations.events: Heater starts on; upward T1=high switches off, downward T1=low switches on; locate roots before restarting integration
equations.analytic_reduction: g2=0 selects prescribed Ta=Tb and fixed T2; Hdot=P-q1
equations.scale: Aii=12, Aij=-1 for 0<abs(i-j)<=5; x_i=1+i/n; b=A*x; 10*n-30 directed links

scope: Synthetic Q0 prototype only; no imported-model or production solver qualification
